# Caleb Appleton

> Partner at Bison Ventures investing in Physical AI, TechBio, and applied AI software. Based in San Francisco.

Caleb Appleton is a venture capital investor and Partner at Bison Ventures. He focuses on early-stage (primarily seed) investments in three areas: physical AI and robotics, technology-enabled biology (TechBio), and applied AI software. He is based in the Presidio in San Francisco, California.

## Pages

- [Home](https://calebappleton.com/): a robot arm workcell; each object on the shelves opens a page
- [About](https://calebappleton.com/about/): background from Texas and Georgia Tech through Bain, Innovation Endeavors, TuneIn and Bison
- [Companies](https://calebappleton.com/companies/): current portfolio and earlier investments
- [Writing](https://calebappleton.com/writing/): articles, blog posts, podcasts and press
- [Adventures](https://calebappleton.com/adventures/): photos from bikepacking, ski touring and gravel rides
- [Robot training](https://calebappleton.com/robot-training/): teach a small robot to walk in the browser
- [Contact](https://calebappleton.com/contact/)

## Role and firm

- **Title:** Partner
- **Firm:** Bison Ventures (https://bison.vc/)
- **Stage:** Pre-seed and seed
- **Sectors:** Physical AI · Robotics · TechBio · Computational Genetics · Applied AI software · Deep tech

## Portfolio

Companies Caleb works with at Bison Ventures (full list at https://calebappleton.com/companies/):

- [Eka Robotics](https://ekarobotics.com/): superhuman dexterity for robots in the physical world (Series A)
- [Cobot](https://www.co.bot/): general purpose robotics and physical AI (Series B)
- [Vivodyne](https://vivodyne.com/): human tissue data at scale, pre-clinically (Series A)
- Stealth TechBio: next-generation radiopharmaceutical platform (Seed)
- [Cosmon](https://cosmon.com/): the AI toolchain for physical world engineering (Seed)
- [Grid Aero](https://grid.aero/): autonomous air logistics platform (Series A)
- [Inner Logic](https://innerlogic.io/): physical AI for healthcare (Seed)
- [Sleuth](https://sleuthinsights.com/): answering complex, strategic biopharma questions using AI (Seed)
- [Passkey](https://www.passkeytx.com/): tackling complex diseases using computational genetics (Seed)

Earlier investments at Innovation Endeavors include Skylo Technologies, Eikon Therapeutics (IPO), Vicarious Surgical (IPO), Dewpoint Therapeutics and BigHat Biosciences.
